question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fatuous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brilliant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fatuous"** means silly, foolish, or lacking intelligence. (मूर्खतापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **His fatuous comment about the serious issue made everyone uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **"Brilliant"** refers to something that is highly intelligent, clever, or outstanding in quality. (प्रतिभाशाली)
 
 
• **Example: **Her brilliant idea saved the company a lot of money.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Fatuous'** is **'Brilliant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Brilliant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dim** (मंद): Not bright or clear; lacking in light or intelligence.

 
 
• **Example: **The dim bulb barely lit up the room.
 
 
 
• **Sappy** (भावुक): Overly sentimental or emotional.
 
 
• **Example: **The movie was too sappy for my taste.
 
 
 
• **Lamebrain** (मूर्ख): A slang term for someone who is not very smart or is foolish.
 
 
• **Example: **Don’t be such a lamebrain; think it through!
 
 

3c:Tbf3,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i
